namedProcesses.runtime: classify each uploaded file, extract each file, pause for human review, cross-check against resolution_data when supplied, generate report
namedProcesses.expectedWorkflowResult: Generated report plus cross-check extracted data

namedProcesses.runtime: OCR each uploaded file, perform UCP 600 / ISBP 821 compliance check, generate report
namedProcesses.expectedWorkflowResult: Generated LC checking report plus compliance extracted data

namedProcesses.runtime: OCR files, compare the first two documents' sections, generate report; handler rejects fewer than two files
namedProcesses.expectedWorkflowResult: Generated comparison report plus comparison extracted data

namedSubmit.acceptedFileBehavior: Non-empty files[] values are appended first, then non-empty source_file, target_file, and file fields in that order; only the first value of each single-file field is used.
namedSubmit.replay: The legacy route did not pass an idempotency key into submitPipelineJob; no workflow-specific replay contract was implemented here.
namedSubmit.profilePins: The worker loads _workflowPrompts for the operation apiKeyId and endpointSlug when creating its context; the legacy workflow route does not persist an immutable prompt snapshot at admission.

schemaSubmit.inputSelector: optional multipart field input containing JSON text

invalidJsonInput.title: Invalid Input
invalidJsonInput.detail: Form field "input" must be a valid JSON object string.

schemaSubmit.oldInputObjectGuard: The route JSON.parse'd input but did not verify it was a non-null, non-array object; a strict object check is an approved security exception and must reject such values.
schemaSubmit.oldSchemaSlugOverride: The old placeholder variables used { schemaSlug, ...input }, so a supplied input.schemaSlug overwrote the route selector. A safe implementation must pin the selected schema and reject or ignore this override.
schemaSubmit.schemaStorage: Legacy loader reads JSON from appSettings key wb_schema:{slug}; it has no tenant fence or revision pin.

securityExceptions: New admission must require an authenticated active public API key, tenant/profile/action authorization, and must not fall back to the oldest ADMIN key.
A multipart apiKeyId cannot choose another principal; reject mismatch or ignore it without changing the authenticated caller.
Legacy operation GET/resume/cancel code does not consistently authenticate and tenant-fence all requests; new operation surfaces must enforce caller tenant ownership.
Legacy schema callback/URL-download execution did not have an explicit safe egress policy; enforce bounded egress/callback policy and test rejection.

operationLifecycle.done: Operation row done boolean; successful and failed rows include a result block; cancelled rows include neither result nor error.
operationLifecycle.progress: metadata.state, current_step, progress_percent, progress_message, and pipeline_steps reflect persisted operation state.
operationLifecycle.resume: POST /api/v1/operations/{id}/resume; legacy body may edit step/extracted_data; resume is allowed only while WAITING_USER_INPUT and re-enqueues the same workflow.
operationLifecycle.cancel: POST /api/v1/operations/{id}/cancel; legacy code immediately sets done=true/state=CANCELLED without waiting for child/provider work to stop; new safe cancellation must stop work and is an intentional lifecycle strengthening.

schemaSemantics.nestedParallel: Parallel branches are arrays of ordered node sequences and may include nested control nodes.
schemaSemantics.join: first returns the first accumulated output; legacy concat and merge both return the accumulated output array.
schemaSemantics.connector: Binds declared inputs, supports node prompt/static-fields/header/response-path/timeout overrides, otherwise resolves a profile prompt override.
schemaSemantics.fileParse: Accepts a bound single file, an array, or an object with files; records parsed text/markdown and returns one output per file.
schemaSemantics.fileUrlDownload: Requires a non-empty URL array, supports auth and allowed extensions, and downloads to operation-scoped storage.
schemaSemantics.callback: Defaults to POST with JSON payload; legacy runner ignores response status and returns callback sent after fetch resolves.
schemaSemantics.archiveCompress: Bundles path or named-content entries into a ZIP buffer.
schemaSemantics.archiveExtract: Reads a ZIP buffer or path and extracts using maxTotalBytes/maxEntries limits when provided.
schemaSemantics.human: Pauses before later flow nodes, persists prior node results, and resumes after operator input.
schemaSemantics.input: Declares a business variable; output is input[key].
